ModMetaData.name: RimTouch 1.7 Beta
ModMetaData.author: Tatsuki Tanaka; Cupears
ModMetaData.description:
Windows touchscreen controls for RimWorld 1.7. Beta 1.
Tap, double tap, long-press menus, map pan, selection boxes, pinch zoom, world map gestures, and menu scrolling.
Native touch capture inside the game window. Remote pointer mode for mouse-only RDP and Steam Link. No global input hooks.
Enable only one RimTouch version. Native mode: separate touch contacts. Remote pointer mode: one-finger gestures and wheel zoom.
Options: Mod settings - RimTouch. Input status and active contact count available.
Original project: iLtanaka/RimTouch. GPL-3.0-or-later.
